LESSON: SELECTED CHAPTER SURAH AL- HUJURAT (Q 49)

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: GRADE
Strand: Qur’an 1.1 Ulum al- Qur’an • Miraculuous nature of Qur’an • Language of the Qur’
Topic 1.2: Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat (Q 49)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat (Q 49), part of Qur’an 1.1 Ulum al- Qur’an • Miraculuous nature of Qur’an • Language of the Qur’ in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: What do Muslims learn from Surah al- Hujurat? 2. How can Muslims use Surah al- Hujurat to enhance peace in the community?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Use the Qur’an to recite Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49),

2. discuss the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat in pairs and make class presentations,

3. research on the teachings of Surah al-Hujurat and make class presentations,

4. discuss the lessons from Surah al-Hujurat in groups and make notes,

5. role-play the teachings/lessons from Surah al-Hujurat, learners with blindness can be given physical support as they role play. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Use the Qur’an to recite Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49),
2. discuss the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat in pairs and make class presentations,
3. research on the teachings of Surah al-Hujurat and make class presentations,
4. discuss the lessons from Surah al-Hujurat in groups and make notes,
5. role-play the teachings/lessons from Surah al-Hujurat, learners with blindness can be given physical support as they role play. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat (Q 49) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: The skill of socio-cultural sensitivity and awareness is enhanced as learners research on the

teachings of Surah al-Hujurat.

• Communication and collaboration: Listening and speaking skills are enhanced as learners discuss the lessons

• Learning to learn: the skill of research is enhanced when learners research on the teachings of Surah al-Hujurat

• Self-efficacy: the skill of effective communication is enhanced when learners role-play the teachings/lessons

Values:

presentations.

● Social justice is enhanced as learners discuss the lessons from Surah al-Hujurat in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

Social Cohesion is enhanced as learners discuss the lessons from Surah al-Hujurat in groups and make notes.

Link to other subjects:

● English as learners explain the meaning of the Surah in English.

● Arabic enhanced as learners read Surah al-Hujurat.
